- Platform readings inherited unchanged (r221 ①–⑥, r228 ⑦–⑨): ① `post-stamped` refuses any bare stamp later than its clock in either spelling, and refuses a body mixing `{{NOW}}` with a bare quoted stamp. ② A `mode:subagent` dev's Edit under `.claude/**` was NOT refused by the auto-mode classifier on four PRs; the refusal is nondeterministic. ③ `write-pace`'s 40-writes-per-hour budget is reachable by one seat landing three PRs in one hour; space the record writes. ④ `check-expected-skips.mjs --pr` exits 3 while any shard is `in_progress`. ⑤ `check-handover.mjs` lists other seats' `pm:dispatched` cards assigned to this account as held by another session when the claim's session differs. ⑥ The relay's `pr_request_reviewers` op works for both approver accounts when the PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`. ⑦ `gh api --paginate` cannot follow this post's comment pages through the session proxy; read the newest comments with `?since=` or `?page=N`. ⑧ `git-history.mjs touch` refuses on the fresh shallow clone for most charter files even after `--deepen=64`; the marker records `git log -1 origin/main -- PATH` for those, with the shallow floor named. ⑨ Relay `pr_ready` / `automerge_enable` strokes are idempotent against a PR a human already readied and armed. New this shift: ⑩ `post-stamped` refuses a `{{WAS:…}}` on a comment's OPENING line (positional-declared) — quoted stamps go in the body, the opening line carries only `{{NOW}}`. ⑪ The relay's `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` pair on a Tier S PR with every check green enqueued within two minutes and the queue merged it in 6–25 minutes (PR #24315: armed 11:30Z, enqueued 11:32Z, merged 11:55Z; PR #24345: armed 14:46Z, enqueued 14:47Z, merged 14:53Z). ⑫ Seat slips this shift, for the successor: the opening-line `{{WAS:…}}` refusal (⑩) bit twice; a shell-interpolated f-string in the 席位核对 of PR #24345 dropped the five required checks' names (the conclusions stood; the landing comment carries the named reading) — build record text in files, not in shell substitutions.
